abort.no_source:
Set up the Garmin Connect integration first; Garmin Dashboard shows the data it provides.

1. [Open Garmin Connect in HACS]({hacs_url}), download it and restart Home Assistant.
2. [Add Garmin Connect]({setup_url}) and sign in.
3. Add Garmin Dashboard again.

More: {docs_url}

source_removed.title: Garmin account for “{profile}” was removed
source_removed.description: The Garmin Connect connection behind the “{profile}” profile no longer exists. Open Garmin Dashboard → Configure to choose another account or remove the profile. Dashboard data is never switched to another account automatically.

unsupported_source.description: Garmin Connect {version} has not been verified with this version of Garmin Dashboard (verified: {supported}). Values that cannot be matched safely are hidden instead of shown wrongly. Update Garmin Dashboard when a compatible release is available.
